Organic Farming
Advantages
Organic farming is .
It can boost the of organic food products.
It can save necessary for producing pesticides and fertilisers.
Comparison with traditional farming
which double in number may attack organic vegetables.
Production of organic vegetables such as tomatoes and is 40% lower.
Winter weed production is lower than it used to be.
Production of organic products for animals including organic keeps the same.

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到有机农业是一个“sustainable”（可持续的）生产系统，直接提取形容词填空即可。
你可能会听到后面的production或system，但空格在is后面作表语，缺的是形容词，不要填成名词。
From this, we can see organic farming is a sustainable production system, which is one of its advantages.
录音提到有机食品的“sales”（销售额）被促进（promoted），完美同义替换了题目中的“boost”（提升）。
你可能听到了“consumer demand”（消费者需求）并想填入，但要注意题目中是“boost the ___ of food products”，真正被拉动的是销售额。

Another benefit is that with the increasing consumer demand for a healthier, more nutritionally balanced product, the sales of organically produced food are promoted. According to the research, it has become the fastest-growing sector of agriculture and has shown an annual increase of at least 20 percent during the last 6 years.
录音中说到有机农业有助于“conservation of essential energy”（基础能源的节约），“conservation”同义替换了题目的“save”。
听到“oil and coal”时不要急着填，它们只是举例说明消耗的不可再生资源，后面的“essential energy”才是对整体宏观的概括。

What's more, both chemical fertilizers and synthetic pesticides consume non-renewable resources such as oil and coal. But the development of organic farming can lower the demand for these fertilizers and pesticides, so it is conducive to the conservation of essential energy.
录音中提到昆虫（insects）的数量是传统农场的两倍（twice as many as），对应题目中的“double in number”，并提到它们会让蔬菜受损（damaged/attack）。
你可能会听到前一句的“earthworms”（蚯蚓），但录音说蚯蚓是三倍（3 times），只有“insects”才是两倍（twice）。

Moreover, the biodiversity in organic farming can also be reflected in the number of insects, which is twice as many as those in traditional farms. This might be highly related to the fact that organic vegetables are grown without any human-made pesticides, making these vegetables more likely to be damaged.
录音举例说有机西红柿和土豆（potatoes）的产量比传统方式低40%，直接填入并列项即可。
此题所听即所得，只要跟紧了前面的“tomatoes”和“40%”这两个明显的定位词，就不容易写错。

The other main difference between organic and traditional farming lies in crop yields, one of the biggest concerns of organic farmers. Organic farms, though possibly well-adapted for certain local environments, produce less food per unit of land. For example, organic vegetables like tomatoes and potatoes yielded are 40 percent less than conventional ones.
录音说冬季杂草的产量现在是90%，比以前减少了（decreased by）10%，对应题目的“lower than it used to be”。
极易错填成“90%”！录音说的是“现在是90%”，而题目问的是“比过去低了多少”，所以要填减少的那个“10%”。
In addition, research has also found the number of weeds produced in winter is about 90 percent at present, which has decreased by 10 percent than before.
录音提到有机产品也用于动物，比如有机草（organic grass），且在最后一句确认了它的产量保持不变（remained constant），对应题目中的“keeps the same”。
不要被中间干扰信息（比如cows，milk）带偏，题目问的是给动物吃的“organic products”，而举的例子就是“grass”。

These days, a variety of organic products are cultivated not only for humans, but also for animals. For example, organic grass. It is commonly used in organic farms to feed cows. Because of the non-use of synthetic fertilizers or pesticides, it can protect cows from diseases brought by large-scale breeding, thus ensuring the quality of raw milk. But an interesting phenomenon is that its production has remained constant these years, which is quite unique compared with other types of crops.

questions.question: What happened to organic farming in India?

analyses.content: 录音最后指出印度农作物的产量（production of crops）每年都在持续增长（kept growing），完美对应选项A的“Yields increased”。
不选B是因为虽然一开始不成功，但录音并没有说农民“不情愿”（reluctant）接受，而是说他们更“习惯”（familiar with）传统的做法。  不选C是因为录音明确提到一开始“不能成功应用”（could not be applied successfully），这与C选项矛盾。

According to one study, organic farming was proposed in India in the early 1960s when it was faced with acute shortages of food grains due to the ever-increasing population and natural disasters. Although it could not be applied successfully at 1st, as farmers had been familiar with conventional instructions, proponents of organic farming claimed that organic agriculture emphasized biodiversity and effective soil management could enhance the capacity to mitigate and even reverse the effects of climate change. So India needed organic farming along with modern scientific agriculture. The study shows that in 2016, India became the country with the largest number of organic products, and the production of crops kept growing year on year.

questions.question: The conclusion in international organic farming review focuses on

analyses.content: 录音结尾用“Therefore”引出结论部分（the last part / conclusion），主要探讨有机农业是否对动物产生积极影响（positive effects to animals），对应选项C的“beneficial to wildlife”。
不选A是因为人们对有机食品感兴趣（interested in organic food）出现在评论的“第一部分（1st part）”，而不是题干问的“结论（conclusion）”。  不选B是因为作者只是在不同国家做了调查（conducted a survey），并没有说去“对比不同国家的方法（comparing different methods）”。

Another international review about organic farming presents in the 1st part that people today have become increasingly interested in organic food, and this opinion is quite the same as that of other articles. But what impressed me most was the volume of the investigation the author did in different countries. He conducted a survey in 99 countries, of which 66 are convinced that organic farming is beneficial to animals, while 8 hold the opposite opinion, and the remaining 25 say it is inconclusive. Therefore, the last part of the review is mainly talking about whether organic farming brings positive effects to animals.

questions.question: According to the speaker, what is the main advantage of organic farming?

analyses.content: 演讲者用“However, as far as I'm concerned”表明自己的核心观点，认为最重要的是购买者（消费者），因为“市场需求决定一切（market demand determines everything）”，对应选项A。
选项B和选项C在录音里都提到了，但那是“其他人认为（Some may think / Others may say）”的优点，而不是题干问的“演讲者认为（According to the speaker）”的观点。

We can see there are different views about the advantages of organic farming. Some may think it can provide more nutritious and healthier food. Others may say it can protect the natural environment and benefit wildlife. However, as far as I'm concerned, it's you, the ones who buy organic products, that will decide what they can bring to you because market demand determines everything.
